Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee

September 15–16, 2026
A joint meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee and the Board of Governors was held in the offices of the Board of Governors.1

Developments in Financial Markets and Open Market Operations
The manager noted that U.S. Treasury yields increased over the intermeeting period. Participants observed that inflation remained elevated and that upside risks to inflation had increased.

Several participants judged that the labor market had softened somewhat, and a few noted downside risks to employment. Many participants saw a tight labor market and inflation pressures as reasons that further policy firming could be appropriate.

Committee Policy Actions
The Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-3/4 to 4 percent, in support of the Federal Reserve's dual mandate.

Notation Vote
By notation vote completed on August 18, 2026, the Committee unanimously approved the minutes of the previous meeting.
